# MCP tools: Projects, domains, processes, tags and saved views

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 12 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `get_work_hierarchy`

Use this for the structure of the user's Work: Domains, Processes and Projects as one bounded page of nodes linked by parent_id.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`.

Returns: `HierarchyOutput` with `nodes` (array of HierarchyNodeRecord), `truncated` (boolean), `next_cursor` (string or null), `tasks` (array of HierarchyTaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `include_tasks` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `100`; 1 to 100 |
| `process_id` | uuid | no | may be null |

## `list_domains`

List bounded domains owned by the authenticated user.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`.

Returns: `DomainPageOutput` with `domains` (array of DomainRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 100 |

## `create_domain`

Use this when the user wants a new Domain, the top-level area that groups Projects and Processes; create it before a Project that needs it.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

Returns: `DomainOutput` with `domain` (DomainRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `name` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `accent` | string | no | one of `slate`, `blue`, `teal`, `green`, `amber`, `orange`, `rose`, `violet`; may be null; Colour accent shown next to the domain name: one of the eight names slate, blue, teal, green, amber, orange, rose or violet. |
| `description` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |

## `update_domain`

Update explicit fields of one owned domain at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

Returns: `DomainOutput` with `domain` (DomainRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | Fields to change: omitted stays, null clears where allowed. |
| `changes.accent` | string | no | one of `slate`, `blue`, `teal`, `green`, `amber`, `orange`, `rose`, `violet`; may be null; Colour accent shown next to the domain name: one of the eight names slate, blue, teal, green, amber, orange, rose or violet. |
| `changes.description` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `changes.last_reviewed_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `changes.name` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `changes.review_cadence` | string | no | one of `daily`, `weekly`, `biweekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `yearly`; may be null |
| `changes.status` | string | no | one of `active`, `archived`; may be null |
| `changes.tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; may be null |
| `domain_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `list_tags`

List the authenticated user's own tag vocabulary as a bounded page, with its use per kind (only kinds you may read).

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`.

Returns: `TagPageOutput` with `tags` (array of TagRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `50`; 1 to 100 |
